messages:
Ivy Lopez: Quick plan check for the pricing experiment bundle: goal is clearer tier names, compact FAQ refresh, and a tiny calculator modal that nudges self-serve. Want to keep it low-risk. Thoughts?
Tom Baker: Sounds good. Suggest 3 naming directions: functional (Starter / Scale / Enterprise), value-led (Hobby / Business / Mission-critical), and shorthand (S / M / L) as control. We can test only two variants + control.
Ravi Singh: Prefer value-led vs control. Also propose the calculator be inline modal with one input: monthly active users (MAU) -> we map to tokens estimate. Simpler UX = higher completion.
Leah Kim: +1 on MAU input. Add microcopy below input: "We convert MAU to estimated tokens for typical chat apps". Also tweak FAQ top Q: "How does billing work?" to mention batching and caching can lower your bill.
Ivy Lopez: Good. Metrics: primary = calc_complete -> conversion to sign-up; secondary = demo-requests and route. Need to capture est_spend bucket.
Tom Baker: For names, propose copy strings tied to benefits so devs know what to expect. I'll draft the 6 strings tonight. Keep character counts under 30 for hero badges.
Ravi Singh: Routing rules idea: if calc_est_spend >= 1000 -> flag high-value -> route to Enterprise SDR; if user clicks "Request demo" always route to SDR. Others go to product-nurture list. Add manual override column in Leads queue.
Leah Kim: We'll want analytics events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_est_spend, pricing_name_variant, pricing_route. Tag experiment id: pricing_pack_v3.
Ivy Lopez: Rollout plan: feature flag gated by experiment id. Canary 5% for EU traffic first, then ramp. Devs need strings + wireframes by Thu EOD.
Tom Baker: Webinar tie-in: 20-min demo + 10-min benchmark snapshot. Benchmarks to include a sample app: chat customer support flow, 1k-user baseline. Show tokens/1k and $/1k with batching on vs off. Plain bullets.
Ravi Singh: I'll generate the numbers and keep them conservative. Use relative % savings instead of exact $s to avoid commitments.
Leah Kim: Nurture flow: for <1000 est_spend send 3-email series: checklist, mini case study, invite to on-demand webinar. For >=1000, trigger SDR outreach and invite to live webinar.
Ivy Lopez: Assign: Tom - tier copy variants + hero badges; Ravi - calculator mapping + benchmark bullets; Leah - FAQ Q1-6 refresh + nurture emails; I'll own the rollout doc + launch post. Deploy Bot: create staging flag?
Deploy Bot: flag pricing-pack-v3 created. CI pipeline triggered. Staging ETA: Thu 18:00 UTC.
Ivy Lopez: OK. Keep this thread for blockers only. I'll share the strings in #docs after Tom posts them.
